# 黃帝陰符經註--俞琰

**ID:** KR5a0126
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0126

## Authors / Editors
- 俞琰

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A twelve-folio Yuán commentary by Yú Yǎn 俞琰 (1258–1314) — a specialist on the *Yìjīng* 易經 and author of *Zhōuyì cāntóng qì fāhuī* ([DZ 1005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a1005)). The preface by Shī Yù 施裕 is dated 1348, posthumous to Yú Yǎn. The text presents the short version (c. 300 words). In doing so, Yú explicitly (11a) follows Zhū Xī 朱熹, who thought that the additional sentences making up the long version (c. 400 words) were in fact commentaries; compare *[DZ 113 Jiǎn Chāngchén's Huángdì yīnfú jīng jiě](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0114)*. Yú gives philological and naturalistic explanations about the world of humanity.

**Abstract**

Florian C. Reiter, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 2:700 (§3.A.1), dates the work by the preface. The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 1258 (Yú Yǎn's birth year) / notAfter 1314 (Yú Yǎn's death year), with dynasty 元; publication was posthumous (1348). Yú Yǎn is the sole catalog-meta person wikilinked.
